best_lineage.idea: Replace the single histogram with 8 private sub-histograms (one per stream position) so that repeated increments of a hot bin hit different cache lines, breaking the store-to-load dependency chain that stalls the simple loop. Keep the prefix sum scalar but process 8 elements at a time and use pointer arithmetic to avoid index conversions.
